purpose: Runs Squire's safety floor as the session runs it, the owner's answer through the prompt hook, Squire's secret helper and the page server as their own command lines, and a loopback connector stand-in, to check that each decision is written once to the record in the owner's folder with its time, job, decision, tool and target and nothing secret or private in it, that the session cannot change the record, that the owner can open it on his Mac behind the link's secret, and that a call is asked when its decision cannot be recorded.
title: The record of what Squire decided and did

testCases.description: every ask, answer, use of a yes, refusal, split and connector call that ran is in the record once
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/squire-record.test.js::every ask with its request, the owner's answer, the use of a yes, a refusal with its reason and a split appear in Squire's record once each, with their time and job, and a connector read, a draft and a send that ran appear by tool name

testCases.description: the record holds no secret and no message body
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/squire-record.test.js::Squire's record holds no secret and no message body: a key the secret helper knows, used through the helper on the owner's yes, and the same key carried in a connector call's input appear in it in no form the helper hides, and no sent, drafted or read message's body appears in it

testCases.description: the session cannot write, change or remove the record by any route
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/squire-record.test.js::the session cannot write, change or remove Squire's record by any tool or shell route: a write over it, a write by another spelling of its name, an edit, and a removal, an append, a move, a truncation, a copy over it, a link in its place and a removal of its folder by the shell are each refused, yes or no, and the record keeps every line it held

testCases.description: the record is shown through the page server behind the link's secret only
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/squire-record.test.js::Squire's record is shown on the Mac through the page server behind the link's secret, and not without it

testCases.description: an unwritable record makes the call asked, saying it cannot be recorded
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/squire-record.test.js::when Squire's record cannot be written, a call whose decision it would hold is not done silently: an allowed connector read, a draft and a send are each asked, saying the decision cannot be recorded, and go on the owner's yes, in the default mode and in auto mode

testCases.description: a key the secret helper knows, in an event title the record keeps or in a mail subject, appears in the record in no form, while the jobs' decisions are there
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/squire-record.test.js::Squire's record holds no secret in a target it keeps or in a field that is not a message's body: a key the secret helper knows, in a calendar event's title and in a mail's subject, each sent on the owner's yes, appears in it in no form the helper hides, while the record still holds those jobs' decisions

testCases.description: a target holding a new line and words shaped like a record line gives its decision one line and adds no yes the owner never gave
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/squire-record.test.js::a target holding a new line and words shaped like a line of Squire's record cannot add one: an event whose title holds a new line and a yes to another request gives its ask one line in the record, and the record holds no yes the owner never gave
